title: Box with a hinged lid
summary: A small box whose lid swings open on a pin made from a piece of 1.75 mm printer filament.

hardware.name: 1.75 mm filament, 80 mm long
hardware.notes: Cut a straight piece from the spool; trim flush after fitting.

motions.label: Lid opens
motions.check: Swings open to just past upright and closes flat; its hinge loops clear the back of the box.

steps.title: Put the lid on
steps.text: Set the lid on the box so its two hinge loops sit either side of the box's middle loop.
steps.check: The three loops line up in a straight row.

steps.title: Push in the hinge pin
steps.text: Push the filament through all three loops from the side, then trim it flush.
steps.check: The lid swings open and shut smoothly and the pin stays put.
